title: Roasted Chicken with Bombay Lemon Potatoes

items: 2 large japanese sweet potatoes (800g),Cut into 1” cubes
1 large or 2 medium onions, cut into large chunks
2” piece of ginger, cut into ½” matchsticks

steps: Preheat the oven to 450°F with the empty 6qt enameled pot (or large baking sheet)
Microwave the sweet potato chunks with 1 TBsp water, covered, for 6 minutes.  Drain and let them steam dry for 2-3 minutes.
Combine in a large bowl: sweet potatoes, onions, bell pepper, garlic, ginger, spices, lemon zest, the lemon juice, 2-3 Tbsp olive oil, ½ tsp salt, ½ tsp pepper
Pat the drumsticks dry then coat lightly with olive oil and season liberally with salt and pepper (or salt/pepper/garlic rub blend).
Carefully remove the hot pot from the oven and add 1-2 Tbsp neutral oil to coat the bottom.  Add the vegetable mixture then layer the drumsticks on top.
Roast uncovered for 25 minutes.  Increase the temperature to 500 and roast for another 20 minutes, checking periodically for desired crisp level.
reviewFlags: The method includes bell pepper without a listed amount.

sourceNote: Adapted from Roasted chicken with lemony Bombay potatoes, Jamie Oliver.
